title: 電阻式記憶體製作
summary: 從阻變截面、SET 與 RESET到權重漂移：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Resistive-switching section and SET and RESET to Weight drift: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 阻變截面 → 電流限制
stages.description: 把「阻變截面」「形成步驟」「電流限制」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Resistive-switching section, Electroforming, Current compliance.

steps.title: 阻變截面：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「不同 RRAM 材料系統未必使用同一機制」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Different RRAM material systems need not share one mechanism.
steps.instruction: 畫兩電極與氧化物，標出細絲型假說及不適用的均勻模型。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw electrodes/oxide and label filamentary assumptions versus uniform switching. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 不同 RRAM 材料系統未必使用同一機制；電極活性會改變離子交換。
steps.observationEn: Different RRAM material systems need not share one mechanism; Electrode reactivity changes ion exchange.
steps.failure: 若採用「把所有阻變元件都視為金屬熔斷」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating all resistive switches as metal fuses", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「阻變截面」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：不同 RRAM 材料系統未必使用同一機制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Resistive-switching section diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Different RRAM material systems need not share one mechanism.

knowledge.title: 阻變截面／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 機制：不同 RRAM 材料系統未必使用同一機制。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: Different RRAM material systems need not share one mechanism.

knowledge.title: 阻變截面／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「把所有阻變元件都視為金屬熔斷」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Treating all resistive switches as metal fuses.

quiz.question: 關於「阻變截面」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Resistive-switching section, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 不同 RRAM 材料系統未必使用同一機制
把所有阻變元件都視為金屬熔斷
把形成和所有後續寫入視為相同初態
optionsEn: Different RRAM material systems need not share one mechanism
Treating all resistive switches as metal fuses
Assuming forming and subsequent writes start identically
quiz.explanation: 不同 RRAM 材料系統未必使用同一機制；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Different RRAM material systems need not share one mechanism. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 阻變截面：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「把所有阻變元件都視為金屬熔斷」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Treating all resistive switches as metal fuses.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「阻變截面」成果，先指出錯誤主張「把所有阻變元件都視為金屬熔斷」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：電極活性會改變離子交換。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Resistive-switching section artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Treating all resistive switches as metal fuses". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Electrode reactivity changes ion exchange. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 不同 RRAM 材料系統未必使用同一機制；電極活性會改變離子交換。
steps.observationEn: Different RRAM material systems need not share one mechanism; Electrode reactivity changes ion exchange.
steps.failure: 若採用「把所有阻變元件都視為金屬熔斷」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating all resistive switches as metal fuses", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「阻變截面」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「電極活性會改變離子交換」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Resistive-switching section, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Electrode reactivity changes ion exchange" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 阻變截面／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 診斷機制：電極活性會改變離子交換。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Electrode reactivity changes ion exchange.

knowledge.title: 阻變截面／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「把所有阻變元件都視為金屬熔斷」與「不同 RRAM 材料系統未必使用同一機制」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Treating all resistive switches as metal fuses" is not equivalent to "Different RRAM material systems need not share one mechanism"; the control must expose their difference.
